summary: Russian forces have advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka according to DeepStateUA. Ukrainian forces conducted strikes in the Black and Azov Seas, hitting 7 vessels including 3 tankers and 4 cargo ships. Significant civilian casualties were reported in Zaporizhzhia and Kramatorsk following Russian strikes.
key_points: Russian forces have advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23670).
Ukrainian drones struck 7 vessels in the Black and Azov Seas, including 3 tankers and 4 cargo ships (Source: @UkraineNow/82788).
Russian forces struck the Eximnefteprodukt plant in Odesa with a Banderol missile, causing a massive fire (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31784).
A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia resulted in one death and three injuries (Source: @UkraineNow/82785).
Russian forces conducted six strikes on residential areas in Kramatorsk, resulting in one death and five injuries (Source: @UkraineNow/82791).
The SBU struck a Russian FSB coordination center in Kherson with 13 drones, causing a large fire (Source: @UkraineNow/82794).
Russian forces used three X-59/X-69 cruise missiles to strike the civilian cargo ship GOLDEN LEO (Source: @UkraineNow/82786).
Six EU countries oppose parts of the 21st anti-Russian sanctions package (Source: @UkraineNow/82789).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have made tactical gains near Rai-Oleksandrivka. Ukrainian maritime strikes successfully targeted seven vessels in the Black and Azov Seas. Aerial strikes in Zaporizhzhia and Kramatorsk have caused civilian casualties and infrastructure damage.

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity aerial strikes and maritime targeting. Russian forces are utilizing ballistic missiles and cruise missiles to target civilian infrastructure and maritime vessels. The advancement near Rai-Oleksandrivka indicates continued ground pressure.
sections.regional_response: The UK has undergone a leadership change, with Andy Burnham replacing Keir Starmer as Prime Minister. Within the EU, six nations including France and Germany are opposing specific provisions of the 21st sanctions package due to economic concerns.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian missile production of Iskander-M is estimated at 50-55 units per month, though recent Ukrainian strikes on the defense industry may have reduced this. The SBU is actively targeting FSB coordination nodes using drone swarms.
